html: Unmethylated CpG DNA, of bacterial origin or released from damaged cells and carried into endosomes with particles, activates TLR9. TLR9 signals through MyD88 to IRAK4 and IRAK1, which with TRAF3 activate the transcription factor IRF7. IRF7 drives the type I interferons, interferon α and β, the main antiviral cytokines, best known from plasmacytoid dendritic cells.
